question.prompt: Name a NASA Gemini mission that flew, or an astronaut who flew on one.

answers.evidence: Gemini 1 was the program's first uncrewed test flight.
Gemini 2 was an uncrewed suborbital flight to test the heat shield.
Gemini 3 was the first crewed Gemini flight.
Gemini 4 carried Ed White on the first American spacewalk.
Gemini 5 flew an eight-day endurance mission in August 1965.
Gemini 6A accomplished a space rendezvous with Gemini 7 in December 1965.
Gemini 7 flew in December 1965 and set a 14-day endurance record.
Gemini 8 achieved the first docking with an uncrewed Agena target vehicle.
Gemini 9A flew with Stafford and Cernan in June 1966.
Gemini 10 flew with Young and Collins in July 1966.
Gemini 11 flew with Conrad and Gordon in September 1966.
Gemini 12 was the final Gemini flight and carried Lovell and Aldrin.
Gordon Cooper flew as command pilot of Gemini 5.
Gus Grissom flew as command pilot of Gemini 3.
Walter M. Schirra flew as command pilot of Gemini 6A.
Neil Armstrong flew as command pilot of Gemini 8.
Frank Borman flew as command pilot of Gemini 7.
Pete Conrad flew on Gemini 5 and commanded Gemini 11.
Jim Lovell flew on Gemini 7 and commanded Gemini 12.
James McDivitt flew as command pilot of Gemini 4.
Thomas P. Stafford flew on Gemini 6A and commanded Gemini 9A.
Ed White flew as pilot of Gemini 4.
John Young flew on Gemini 3 and commanded Gemini 10.
Buzz Aldrin flew as pilot of Gemini 12.
Eugene Cernan flew as pilot of Gemini 9A.
Michael Collins flew as pilot of Gemini 10.
Richard F. Gordon flew as pilot of Gemini 11.
David Scott flew as pilot of Gemini 8.

question.explanation: NASA flew 12 Gemini missions: two uncrewed test flights and ten crewed flights. Sixteen different astronauts flew in the program. Astronauts selected only for backup or canceled assignments do not count.
